snippet.title: India's Worst Plane Crash | Only Mid-Air Collision in History | Dhruv Rathee
snippet.description:
India witnessed the worst air crash in its history when 2 planes crashed in the air leading to the death of more than 300 people. This crash took place in a village named Charkhi Dadri near Delhi in 1996, and it became the deadliest case of its kind in the world. But what exactly happened? What was the cause of this crash? What were the findings of the Black Box? Watch this video to find out where I talk about the Charkhi-Dadri Mid Air Plane Collision and everything you need to know about it.
